This establishes source preparation and scoring, not an author baseline. Historical preprocessing, Table 12 classifier/checkpoint parity and seed/run aggregation remain unresolved.

target.description: Four-class motor-imagery classification: left fist, right fist, both fists and feet; the original PhysioNet-MI downstream endpoint, not MAE reconstruction or few-shot transfer.

dataset.description: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset v1.0.0. All 654 official imagery EDFs were authenticated against the official SHA-256 manifest, and the released-code profile produced the paper-reported 9,837 four-second examples. Raw/derived manifests and arrays remain external operator artifacts; this authentic preparation does not establish historical filtering or model parity.

cohort.description: All 109 source participants, with no extra subject exclusions or smaller cohort; imagery runs 04, 06, 08, 10, 12 and 14. The actual preparation retained this complete 109-by-six recording roster.

split.description: Source participants 1–70 train, 71–89 validation and 90–109 test. The complete released-code preparation yielded 6,300 training, 1,734 validation and 1,803 test epochs on that fixed partition. A new subject/montage split is an extension.

inputs.description: The same 64-channel four-second EEG windows and electrode positions. The concrete route preserves float64 microvolts until division by 100 and float32 conversion, and the exact source geometry agrees with the official position bank. Match the released REVE-Base pretrained access and original downstream label availability; no additional target-person calibration may enter this comparison. The released encoder identity does not establish the missing Table 12 trained classifier or exposure parity.

preprocessing.description: Paper C.5 specifies loading at 128 Hz after a 64 Hz low-pass then resampling to 200 Hz. Pinned released code average-references, high-passes at 0.3 Hz, notches 60 Hz and resamples directly to 200 Hz; that profile was actually run on the complete panel and yielded 9,837 epochs. All 18 native-128-Hz recordings from participants 88, 92 and 100 were retained; one final imagery event in S104R08 was dropped by the unchanged four-second boundary rule. Current source geometry and event accounting are established, but matching the count does not identify the historical Table 12 filter/interpolation recipe, environment or numerical parity.

metric.description: Balanced accuracy is mean class recall, (1/4) sum_c TP_c/(TP_c+FN_c), higher is better. Cohen kappa and support-weighted F1 are required supporting metrics, not substitute winning endpoints. The concrete scorer and paired comparator were exercised on all 1,803 original test events using frozen constant-output software controls; those controls are not author or candidate model performance.

aggregation.description: Table 12 reports REVE-Base 0.6480 ± 0.0140 as mean ± standard deviation. Pinned released dt.test concatenates all test events before calculating balanced accuracy, kappa and weighted F1; its primary reduction is pooled epochs rather than a participant mean. Historical Table 12 provenance must still bind that reduction to the original seed/run roster, repeat count and SD denominator. Participant-cluster summaries cannot replace the original primary aggregation.

published_baseline.description: Table 12 REVE-Base, PhysioNet-MI balanced accuracy 0.6480 ± 0.0140 (reported standard deviation); this is a published aggregate, not a local rerun.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Complete authentic source preparation and a numerical evaluator are now exercised, and a strict full-classifier prediction adapter is implemented. No authenticated same-protocol Table 12 downstream checkpoint or author rerun result is established; no model inference or fitting ran. The pinned official pretrained release supplies an encoder, not the required trained four-class head. Local spectral/ridge/NCM helpers or constant-output software controls cannot replace REVE-Base.

minimum_effect.rationale: A practically meaningful gain must be set after historical run variability and classification error impact are quantified; the published standard deviation is not a minimum-effect threshold.

uncertainty.method: Before admission, freeze paired candidate/author evaluation over the original test participants and matched training seeds; retain original paper score aggregation and report participant-cluster uncertainty. The implemented paired participant bootstrap is descriptive and excludes training-seed variation. Exact confidence rule, historical replication and a justified paper-win decision remain unresolved.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participant for generalization; training seed is a separate algorithmic-variation axis.
uncertainty.rationale: Epochs within a participant are dependent; source aggregate standard deviation does not establish independent participant uncertainty.

paper_win_requires: Recover and bind the precise Table 12 preprocessing, all eligible epochs, original run aggregation and REVE-Base access.

Exceed the source-paper balanced accuracy and a calibrated author rerun under identical original subjects, runs, labels, preprocessing and inputs, by the predeclared justified effect with uncertainty.
Freeze candidate and hyperparameters using only participants 1–89 before final evaluation on all source test participants 90–109.
Do not treat better frozen-feature, few-shot, altered-montage, smaller-cohort or new-split results as a Table 12 paper win.

current_sota.description: The source-paper comparison is distinct from current SOTA; no current-SOTA search or claim is admitted by this contract.

episode.improvement_loop: After admission, iterate on original training and validation participants; retain adaptation curves only as separately identified source endpoints.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze model/checkpoint, preprocessing, class/window manifests, label/pretraining access, hyperparameters, seeds, stopping rules and metric aggregation before test scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: One protected evaluation phase on the complete original test partition after exact author calibration and uncertainty/effect policies are accepted.
episode.baseline_policy: Calibrate against the original REVE-Base Table 12 recipe; distinguish published 0.6480, the author rerun and other models. A successful numerical reconstruction is calibration only. Where the source protocol itself uses stochastic draws, a faithful rerun may use declared provenance, a justified reproduction tolerance and paired candidate-author draws; fixed source partitions and full original condition support must remain unchanged.

blocking_issues: Historical Table 12 preprocessing and numerical parity remain unresolved: the exercised released direct-200-Hz profile matches the original epoch count but does not resolve the paper's intermediate-128-Hz description or historical filter/interpolation environment.

Original Table 12 trained downstream classifier/checkpoint identity, seed/run roster, repeat count and SD convention remain unbound. Released-code pooled-epoch reduction and pretrained encoder identity are established separately.

No authentic author-model reproduction or candidate comparison has run. A calibrated author baseline, fixed scientific access/resource budgets, justified effect and predeclared uncertainty decision rule are still required; preparation resource receipts do not authorize or define a model campaign.

Original pretraining/downstream exposure and checkpoint lineage still require qualification. The concrete operator path has complete authenticated data and an exercised scorer, but it is trusted-operator execution; protected untrusted-candidate transport is not established.

legacy.notes: Preserve all REVE S8 reconstruction and engineering materials. The local package covers many tasks and explicitly disables execution; its authored fixed references and prospective endpoints are calibration/development components and do not demonstrate a PhysioNet-MI paper win. The separate additive original-physionet route now provides authenticated full-panel preparation, scoring and a strict classifier adapter; it neither activates the preserved S8 execution entrypoint nor establishes author-model reproduction or improvement.
